target_customer: Individual developers and power users who want local-first, open-source AI and note tools
problem: User data and AI memory sit in siloed apps; Epicenter stores work in plain text and SQLite so tools share memory.
business_model: open-source local-first apps, monetization not stated
product_category: open-source local-first productivity apps and shared memory

founders.name: Braden Wong
prior_employers: three unnamed YC startups (self-reported on YC page)
education: Yale, ethics, politics and economics (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Solo founder; YC page reports about 10k commits per year.

technical_complexity.rationale: Local-first sync, plain text plus SQLite storage and multiple apps are standard engineering with some hard parts for a solo founder.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and plain-text formats make it intentionally portable and copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT memory in April 2025 and Anthropic added project memory in 2025, per a 2026 roundup.

market_need_then: ChatGPT expanded memory in April 2025 and vendors such as Mem0 pushed portable memory, showing interest in memory, but willingness to pay for open-source tools is unproven.

branding.community_and_virality: First app Whispering is open source; GitHub org EpicenterHQ exists; star counts not verified

brand_strength.rationale: Common-word name shared with many unrelated organizations, and no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Shared memory ecosystem pitched at launch
pivots.to: Where one person's software lives, small apps run on own computer and opened from other devices
pivots.why: not stated; site tagline differs from the YC description

outcome_analysis: Epicenter is a solo founder open-source project in developer preview. No verified funding or revenue was found and the positioning has shifted from shared AI memory toward personal software hosting. Platform vendors adding memory features are the main competitive pressure.
notes: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed (Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund) dated September 2025; aggregator only, unverified, not recorded as a round. Competitor search found only 2026 roundups, no dated competition near the batch, so list empty. Pivot date approximate. Acquisition of a different Epicenter (Epicenter Experience by Stagwell) is unrelated. Branding search returned nothing relevant.
